title: CustomOverlay
description: CustomOverlay allows placing images over your Minecraft screen. Access the menu with I, edit with O, and use Shift for grid snapping. Supports many formats like PNG and GIF.
body:
# Overview
**CustomOverlay** is a lightweight yet powerful Minecraft mod that allows you to place custom images directly onto your screen. Whether you want to add a unique aesthetic touch, display helpful reference charts, or keep your favorite memes in sight while playing, this mod gives you full control over your in-game visuals.
_______________________________________________________________________________________________
# **Keybindings**:
1.  **I**: Opens the Image Menu. Browse and select the images you want to display.
2.  **O**: Opens the Overlay Editor. Move, scale, and reposition your images anywhere on the screen.
3.  **Shift** (while in Editor): Activates the Grid System to help you align your overlays with pixel-perfect precision.
_______________________________________________________________________________________________
# **How to Add Images**
1. Navigate to your Minecraft directory: **.minecraft\config\CustomOverlay\images**.
2. **Drop** your **desired image** files into this folder.
3. Back in the game, open the Image Menu (I) and **click the Reload** button to refresh your library.
_______________________________________________________________________________________________
# **Supported Formats**
CustomOverlay supports a wide range of file types to ensure compatibility with almost any image:
1. Standard: **.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .bmp**
2. Animated: **.gif**
3. Advanced/Design: **.webp, .tga, .tiff, .tif, .ico**
> Tip: Use transparent .png or .webp files for the cleanest look, allowing your images to blend seamlessly with the Minecraft UI!
________________________________________________________________________________________________
